description: A tuple for expression with a null condition takes no part in unifying when it isn't selected
notes: The spec doesn't say whether a null condition is an error (native/for/condition-null-is-error), nor what type a failed result that isn't selected has. hashicorp/hcl treats the null condition as an error, evaluates both results (ConditionalExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go), and ForExpr.Value gives the dynamic value when a condition is null. Because one result has the dynamic pseudo-type, it skips unification and returns the selected result unconverted.
